workload: Open-order balances for 500 customer accounts at month end
selection: Sizes and all arms fixed before first run; no target ratio, no omitted slower control
engine: SQLite bundled with official native arm64 PHP 8.4.26 image
data: Deterministic synthetic integer-cent orders; streaming insertion into two fresh in-memory databases per size
validation: All 500 result rows equal independent PHP oracle on every run; full raw results retained
timing: Warm in-memory read queries and full result materialization; fixture load/index build excluded and recorded separately
resource: Process user+system CPU; allocated SQLite page bytes; no energy/billing/write-throughput claim
baseline: Identical correlated SQL without supporting index
control: Grouped aggregate plus left join on the indexed database
